Main_Manuscript.tab:static-rmse: Overall static-fit RMSE summaries. The Q-only and joint Q/R targets have different observation sets.
Main_Manuscript.tab:enkpf: Overall matched EnKF and EnKPF fitting summaries. The Poisson observation criterion uses 12 nominal parameters across three waves and is interpreted descriptively for these adaptive filters.
Main_Manuscript.tab:focused-peak-results: Completed original peak-origin forecast comparisons for all three countries. Scores cover the full held-out remainder. Coverage is EnKPF's latent central 95% interval coverage, in percent.
Main_Manuscript.tab:policy: Mean reduction in the simulated active-case peak across three waves. Both scenarios increase $\beta_f$ by 5%; activation occurs after 10% (early) or 30% (late) of elapsed wave duration.

Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s1: Initial parameter guesses used in the country MATLAB scripts.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s2: Wave-specific population and initial-state construction. $Q_0$ and $R_0$ are observed counts, and $\widehat I_{0,w}$ is estimated for wave $w$.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s4: JB endpoint marginal-normality rejection counts, among four parameters per country--wave, using the finite-ensemble MATLAB convention at 5%.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s5: Mardia tests of current full-wave hybrid-comparison EnKF endpoint ensembles. The joint null is rejected if either p-value is below 0.05.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s6: Matched EnKF and standalone PF RMSE pooled across the joint Q/R observations.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s7: Matched EnKF and standalone PF reported Poisson observation criterion.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s8: Standalone PF diversity diagnostics for 200 particles. ESS statistics are evaluated before resampling. Parent-count means include all steps, with 200 recorded when resampling is omitted.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s9: Current matched wave-level RMSE for Q and R, evaluated separately.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:s10: Intervention activation times in days since wave start and simulated peak reduction. Both scenarios increase $\beta_f$ by 5%; early activation is at 10% and late activation at 30% of elapsed wave duration. Values within $10^{-4}$ percentage points of zero are rounded to zero.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:oos-splits: Completed retrospective peak origins, training/test lengths, and original random seeds.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:oos-rmse-r2: Held-out peak-origin forecast RMSE and coefficient of determination for current canonical runs.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:oos-coverage-aic: Peak-origin central 95% ensemble-interval coverage and legacy residual score. The residual score ranks RSS rather than independently assessing calibration.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:source-protocols: Distinct analysis protocols used in the manuscript. Reference ensembles must be matched to their own experiment.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:lhs-bounds: Common Latin hypercube parameter bounds used for the current global PRCC figure.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:lhs-windows: Country--wave sensitivity integration windows. Duration is elapsed days between the first and last reporting dates.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:amm-recovery: Idealized Poisson parameter recovery across 20 paired replicates per generating vector. Relative bias and RMSE are percentages; every selected fit is retained.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:amm-information: Unregularized information diagnostics at the generating parameter vectors. Condition is $\operatorname{cond}(J_w^\top J_w)$; the last column is $\sigma_{\min}(J_w)$ for the weighted log-parameter Jacobian. Numerical rank and conditioning are local, design-specific measures.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:focused-eligibility: Completion and training-initializer diagnostics for the native peak forecasts. All completed origins enter the primary analysis; positive optimizer termination flags define a separate sensitivity subset.
Supplementary_Manuscript.tab:focused-seed-summary: Fourteen-day repeated-seed forecasts for all three completed peak origins and the converged-initializer sensitivity subset. Both summaries retain all five declared seeds and both outcomes at each included origin.
